references.name: Sitka / GORE Optifade (Open Country, Subalpine, Elevated II, Cover)
references.note: Same CONCEPT family as Owner Base (macro + pixel micro). Concept overlap is expected and is not copying; the image-level check against a real swatch is the open item.

references.name: MARPAT (USMC) / CADPAT (Canada)
references.note: Fully pixelated (no traced organic macro). Owner Base macro is organic blobs on a 5.6-unit trace grid with 45 deg corners; pixels only on blob edges.

references.name: KUIU Valo
references.note: 6 described colours vs our 4; palette families overlap (tan, olive, near-black) as they do for most western patterns.

references.name: KUIU Vias
references.note: Grey-dominant rock palette; Owner Base has no grey ink.

references.name: KUIU Verde / Verde 2.0
references.note: Green-dominant; Owner Base mean colour is a dry-grass tan-olive (#8C8056).

references.name: First Lite Fusion / Cipher / Specter
references.note: No structural description published, so no class comparison is possible; needs the image check.
